findings.message: Exact multiples add an extra empty page: floor(total/pageSize)+1 adds one page even when the division is exact. total=40/pageSize=20 returns 3 instead of 2.
Missing null check: the payload is dereferenced before validation and crashes on null input.
Cache key ignores tenant id, allowing cross-tenant cache reads and a data leak.
Role check is inverted: the admin-only branch runs when role is not admin, so members can access admin resources.
